title_en: Wang Xiaohong Stresses at National Public Security Video Conference: Study and Implement Xi Jinping's Important Reply Letter Spirit, Shoulder the Duty of Safeguarding People's Wellbeing and Homeland Security
summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，国务委员、公安部部长王小洪在全国公安机关视频会议上强调，要深入学习贯彻习近平总书记重要回信精神，坚决扛牢守百姓幸福、护家国平安的重任。
summary_en: On September 22, 2026, State Councilor and Public Security Minister Wang Xiaohong addressed a national public security video conference, urging police to study and implement Xi Jinping's important reply letter spirit and safeguard the people's wellbeing and homeland security.
